BASIC GYM WORKOUT PLAN

Monday – Chest + Triceps
- Bench Press – 4 x 8–10
- Chest Fly – 3 x 12
- Incline Dumbbell Press – 3 x 10
- Cable Triceps Pushdown – 3 x 12
- Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension – 3 x 10
- Close-Grip Bench Press – 3 x 8

Tuesday – Back + Biceps
- Lat Pulldown – 4 x 10
- Barbell / Machine Row – 3 x 10
- Seated Cable Row – 3 x 12
- Dumbbell Curl – 3 x 10
- Cable Curl – 3 x 12
- Barbell Curl – 3 x 8

Wednesday – Legs
- Leg Press – 4 x 12
- Barbell / Smith Squats – 4 x 8
- Leg Extension – 3 x 12
- Leg Curl – 3 x 12
- Dumbbell Lunges – 3 x 10 each leg
- Standing Calf Raises – 4 x 15

Thursday – Shoulders + Abs
- Dumbbell Shoulder Press – 4 x 10
- Cable Lateral Raise – 3 x 12
- Barbell Upright Row – 3 x 10
- Dumbbell Front Raise – 3 x 12
- Cable Crunch – 3 x 15
- Leg Raises – 3 x 12

Friday – Chest + Back
- Bench Press – 4 x 8
- Lat Pulldown – 4 x 10
- Cable Chest Fly – 3 x 12
- Barbell Row – 3 x 10
- Dumbbell Pullover – 3 x 12

NOTE: Friday's remaining exercises, if any, and the rest of the plan are cut off in the screenshots provided.
